description.zh: 在任何地方打出缩写，再按空格或标点，就换成设好的文字：cmd 变成 command，;addr 变成你的地址。紧接着按退格可以撤回。管理员身份运行的窗口里用不了
description.en: Type an abbreviation anywhere, then a space or punctuation, and it becomes the text you set: cmd becomes command, ;addr your address. Backspace right after takes it back. Not in windows run as administrator

notes.zh: 新插件：缩写展开。在任何地方打 `cmd` 再按空格、回车、Tab 或标点，就换成 `command`；缩写和内容在插件卡片上自己写，一行一条，内容可以有好几行；紧接着按退格撤回。输入法在打中文时、Win顺 自己的窗口里、以管理员身份运行的窗口里不展开，也可以列出不用的程序。在 Win顺 里输入 `缩写` 列出、暂停。需要 Win顺 0.41.0。
notes.en: New plugin: text expander. Type `cmd` and a space, Enter, Tab or a punctuation mark anywhere and it becomes `command`; the abbreviations are yours, written on the plugin's card one per line, and may run over several lines; Backspace right after takes it back. Not while the input method composes Chinese, in WinShun's own windows or in windows run as administrator, nor in programs you list. Type `expander` in WinShun to list and pause them. Needs WinShun 0.41.0.
